notes: All seven web searches ran this time (the six required plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act). None of the five name-plus-topic searches (superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, pause or slowdown or moratorium, China agreement or treaty, AI safety) returned any page mentioning Bentz. The official-site search returned only the June 2025 hydropower statement. The quote in that statement came through a page-fetch tool that would only give a short fragment, so the exact wording and punctuation (including the comma after 'artificial intelligence') should be checked on the page; a second address under /media/press-releases/ for the same title returned HTTP 404. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538): the fastdemocracy.com bill page (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/) lists 12 cosponsors and Bentz is not among them; news reports name other cosponsors and none name Bentz. Congress.gov was not checked (it returned HTTP 403 in the earlier attempt). No House letter about AI risk led or signed by him was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). Kept from the earlier attempt: his official press release listing (https://bentz.house.gov/media/press-releases, pages 1 and 2, about 30 releases from 12 December 2025 to 11 November 2026) showed no title or excerpt mentioning AI, superintelligence, China AI talks or data centers; only excerpts were seen, not full texts.
